worldrelay.creation.failed: Could not prepare the shared world. Check settings or networking and retry. Any acquired ownership is retained for recovery.
worldrelay.creation.cancel_failed: Cancellation has not been confirmed. Other players may still need to wait. Retry cancellation; local data will be kept.
worldrelay.creation.start_failed: Creation did not complete. Local data and ownership are retained. Retry is possible before world files are created; existing data requires recovery support.
worldrelay.creation.unfinished: The previous world creation or save did not finish safely. Local files and ownership are retained and require recovery before continuing.
worldrelay.creation.not_available: This world is preparing, synchronizing or waiting for its host to recover. Refresh and retry later.
worldrelay.creation.connect_failed: Could not connect to the shared world. Check your network and retry.
worldrelay.creation.tunnel_unavailable: The shared world connection is unavailable and will retry automatically. Ownership and local progress are retained; other players cannot join yet.
worldrelay.creation.mod_mismatch: Your Minecraft or mod versions differ from the host. Use matching versions and retry.
worldrelay.creation.ownership_lost: Ownership is no longer valid and hosting has stopped. Local progress is retained. Do not submit using the old session.
worldrelay.disconnect.tunnel_identity_mi: The login player does not match the authenticated tunnel account. Check your client account.
worldrelay.creation.downloading: Downloading world changes and verifying the complete save...
worldrelay.creation.download_failed: Download, verification or startup did not finish. Check networking, sync settings and mod versions, then retry. Saves and ownership are retained.
worldrelay.creation.uploading: Saving and uploading world changes... You will return to the shared world list after completion.
worldrelay.creation.upload_failed: The save commit has not been confirmed. Local snapshots and ownership are retained. Check sync settings or networking, then retry.
worldrelay.creation.save_failed: The world did not save and stop cleanly. Upload was blocked; local files and ownership are retained. Check logs and recover the save before committing.
worldrelay.creation.player_message: This shared world has no data for your current account. Join as a new player? Other players' progress will be preserved.
worldrelay.shared_worlds.load_failed: Could not load shared worlds. Check server settings or your connection and refresh the list.
worldrelay.shared_worlds.http_warning: Warning: HTTP is unencrypted. Your player name and Token can be intercepted.
worldrelay.shared_worlds.description.fre: Join from the last synced save and host the world on your computer.
worldrelay.shared_worlds.description.run: Join the world running on the current host's computer.
worldrelay.shared_worlds.description.pre: The host is preparing a new world or synchronizing a save.
worldrelay.shared_worlds.description.sta: The host is starting the world. Please wait for the port to open.
worldrelay.shared_worlds.description.sto: The host is closing the world.
worldrelay.shared_worlds.description.com: The host has reported upload completion. Waiting for server verification and publication; ownership is retained.
worldrelay.shared_worlds.description.rec: The previous host has not finished syncing the save. Please wait for recovery.
worldrelay.settings.title: Shared World Settings
worldrelay.settings.rsync_mode.bundled_t: Use the rsync and SSH included with the mod. No paths are needed.
worldrelay.settings.rsync_mode.auto_tool: Find installed rsync and SSH on the system PATH. Install the tools or choose custom paths if detection fails.
worldrelay.settings.rsync_mode.custom_to: Choose rsync and SSH separately. Both executable paths are required.
worldrelay.settings.rsync_path_tooltip: Enter the full absolute path to rsync, without quotes or arguments.
worldrelay.settings.ssh_path_tooltip: Enter the full absolute path to SSH. It may be in a different directory from rsync.
worldrelay.settings.error.protocol_inval: The server address must use HTTP or HTTPS.
worldrelay.settings.error.domain_invalid: Enter a server address without paths or parameters. Enter the port separately.
worldrelay.settings.error.port_invalid: The port must be an integer from 1 to 65535.
worldrelay.settings.error.token_required: Enter the Token assigned by your server.
worldrelay.settings.error.token_invalid: Token must have no whitespace or controls and at most 4096 characters.
worldrelay.settings.error.rsync_mode_una: Bundled tools are unavailable on this system. Choose auto-detect or custom paths.
worldrelay.settings.error.rsync_path_inv: Enter the full absolute path to rsync, without quotes or arguments.
worldrelay.settings.error.ssh_path_inval: Enter the full absolute path to SSH, without quotes or arguments.
worldrelay.settings.error.rsync_path_una: rsync is missing, unreadable or not executable. Check the path and permissions. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.ssh_path_unava: SSH is missing, unreadable or not executable. Check the path and permissions. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.rsync_not_foun: rsync was not found on PATH. Install it or choose custom paths. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.ssh_not_found: SSH was not found on PATH. Install it or choose custom paths. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.load_failed: Could not load settings. Enter them again and save.
worldrelay.settings.error.save_failed: Server verified, but settings could not be written. Check disk space and config permissions.
worldrelay.settings.error.operation_fail: Could not verify or save settings. Retry and check the client log.
worldrelay.settings.error.ping_initializ: Could not initialize networking. Retry and check the client log. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.ping_address_i: Invalid server address. Check the domain and port. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.ping_timeout: Server timed out. Check the address or retry later. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.ping_tls_faile: HTTPS verification failed. Check the certificate and domain. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.ping_connectio: Connection failed. Check the domain, port and network. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.ping_unauthori: Authentication failed. Check the Token for this player name. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.ping_unsupport: Ping is unavailable. Check the address or update the server. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.ping_redirect: Server redirected. Enter the final server address and port. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.settings.error.ping_response_: Unexpected response. Check the WorldRelay server address. Settings not saved.
worldrelay.disconnect.player_data_confir: Your player data is missing from this shared world. Creating new player data requires confirmation.
worldrelay.disconnect.player_data_unread: Your player data in this shared world cannot be read. Joining was cancelled to protect your progress. See the host's log for details.
